title: Pick List
description: The Pick List of one Accepted Order (UC-004), in the format the Warehouse owns (`docs/inputs/warehouse-picklist-format.md`, C-012): a UTF-8, comma-separated file named `PL-<Order Number>.csv` with a header line and the columns below in this order. This schema describes the file as an array of its rows, one object per row keyed by the column names; numbers are written as digits. A value that holds a comma or a double quote is enclosed in double quotes, and a double quote inside it is doubled (RFC 4180, C-012, UC-004 BR-003).

order_no.description: Order Number, the same on every row.

unit_weight_g.description: Weight of one item in grams.

ship_street.description: Street line, address lines joined by ", ". Personal data (C-021).

total_weight_g.description: Total Weight of the Order in grams, the same on every row (UC-004 BR-002).
